issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds 'Đấng ban sức mạnh cho tôi' (The One who gives me strength) as an appositive/description for Christ. The Greek text 'εν τω ενδυναμουντι' is a prepositional phrase meaning 'in the strengthening' or 'in the power' (specifically the power of strengthening). It does not describe Christ as a person who gives strength, but rather identifies the source/means of the ability as being 'in the strengthening'.
